history.period: Modern (late 20th-21st century; precise construction date not documented)
history.summary: A popular modern city temple of Lord Shiva in the form of Omkareshwar, located at Jai Nagar (also listed as Vardhaman Nagar / Mahabal area) in Jalgaon city. It is administered by the Omkareshwar Devsthan Charitable Trust, which also runs medical, education and social activities. The temple celebrates Mahashivratri, Shravani Somvar, Ram Navami and Gokulashtami on a large scale. NOTE (verify): this is a local city Shiva temple, NOT the famous Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga on Narmada island in Madhya Pradesh; listing sites show this temple under both Jai Nagar and Vardhaman Nagar addresses, which appear to be the same temple (Vardhaman Nagar listing says 'near Jayanagar').

name: Omkareshwar Mandir (Jai Nagar)
town_description: Jalgaon is the largest city of the Khandesh region and the headquarters of Jalgaon district in North Maharashtra, a major banana-producing and trading hub. It lies on the main Mumbai-Bhopal rail line and NH-53, about 400 km northeast of Mumbai.

travel.airport: Jalgaon Airport (~6 km from city centre; no scheduled services as of sources); nearest operating airport Aurangabad (~160 km)
travel.railway: Jalgaon Junction (~3 km), on the main Mumbai-Bhopal rail line
travel.road: Jai Nagar / Mahabal area, ~2 km from Jalgaon bus stand; JMTU city buses, autos and taxis available

visitor_information.opening_hours: Listed as Mon 6:00 AM-10:00 PM; Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 6:00 AM-12:00 PM; Wed 9:00 AM-12:00 PM (source conflict: Justdial lists 6:00 AM-8:00 PM daily for the Vardhaman Nagar listing - verify before visiting)
